summary: Frontend-only verification of the JournalDrawer (Codex) feature. Logged in as test@erchis.io (Erethon L2), opened the Journal from HUD, exercised all 7 tabs, verified data-testids, cache-on-reopen behavior, and HUD regression. Every acceptance criterion in the review request passes. One minor a11y warning observed (Radix `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle`).

issues: Radix a11y warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for screen readers. The visible <h2> 'THE BOOK OF ERCHIS' is not wired as the Dialog title. Wrap it (or an sr-only variant) with the shadcn `SheetTitle` primitive to silence the console warning and improve a11y.

action_items: Non-blocking a11y polish: add a `SheetTitle` (or `VisuallyHidden` + DialogTitle) inside `SheetContent` in JournalDrawer.jsx so Radix stops warning that DialogContent lacks a title.
critical_code_review_comments: JournalDrawer.jsx: `SheetContent` (Radix Dialog under the hood) has no `SheetTitle` — triggers a console error each open. The visible <h2> in the parchment header is not wired as aria-labelledby. Cosmetic + a11y only, no functional impact.

JournalDrawer.jsx line 47: fetch error is swallowed into a single string with no retry. If one of the 7 /api/game/data/* calls fails, all seven remain unset (data stays null) and the user only sees 'Codex sealed. Try again.' with no way to retry inside the drawer — user must close and reopen. Consider a retry button or per-endpoint fallback.

JournalDrawer.jsx line 24: cache invalidation is per-mount forever — if the backend catalog changes during a session (e.g. new items seeded), users won't see it until page reload. Acceptable for MVP since /api/game/data/* is static, but worth noting.

Preface uses `.italic` on a `narr` class quote; on the current parchment palette contrast is fine but the em-dash prefix line is text-primary/70 which is faint on dark bg — readable but noticeably lower contrast than body text.

The Bestiary uses `Object.entries(grouped)` iteration order to determine continent order. In modern JS this is insertion order (from monster array), which happens to match the seed monster order. If backend re-orders monsters, continents may appear in a different order than the WORLD tab. Consider iterating `continents` explicitly for canonical ordering.

The Materials rarity headers use `${RARITY_COLORS[r]}` but 'common' maps to `text-foreground/80`, which visually matches body copy — the section header 'COMMON' does not stand out from the item names below. Minor visual polish.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified data-testids: btn-journal-open, journal-drawer, journal-tab-{intro,stats,statuses,races,world,bestiary,materials}, journal-race-{human,elf,dwarf,half_elf,orc,wildblood,hyliondrian,sylvan}, journal-continent-{aetheria,vulkaros,nyxmoor,frosthelm,zephyria,sablewaste,verdania}, journal-monster-* (54 total incl. gray_wolf, kraken_spawn), journal-item-* (97 total across 6 rarity buckets). Second open of the Journal triggered ZERO new /api/game/data/* calls (state cached — verified via request interceptor). Escape closes drawer; button stays visible; HUD (Erethon character sheet + STATUS badges Bleeding(3) + Weary(3)) intact after close. Notes for future runs: (1) login flow requires clicking the 'Sign In' link on homepage — /login route redirects to /. (2) The materials tab tests using `innerText` will see UPPERCASE due to CSS `uppercase` — check `textContent` or use case-insensitive matching. (3) Radix Sheet fires a console error each open about missing DialogTitle — safe to ignore for now but should be fixed.
